title: Covert Bias: The Severity of Social Views’ Unalignment in Language Models Towards Implicit and Explicit Opinion
reasoning: The study specifically evaluates and benchmarks the behavior of Large Language Models regarding 'religious bigotry' and religious intolerance. It utilizes datasets focused on religious stances (e.g., Atheism vs. Religion) to measure how models calibrate their responses and express certainty when faced with conflicting religious viewpoints.
